description: This file defines the EmployeeTimesheetMenuConfigurator class, which implements the MenuConfigurator interface to configure menu screens related to employee timesheets in the OrangeHRM system. It overrides the screen to 'viewEmployeeTimesheet' using a trait.

classes.name: EmployeeTimesheetMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the menu for employee timesheet screens in the HRM system, overriding the screen to 'viewEmployeeTimesheet'. This class implements the MenuConfigurator interface.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the current screen to 'viewEmployeeTimesheet' using a helper method from a trait, and returns null.
